worldcombat.skill.aurorabeam.summary: Fire a rainbow beam that runs along the line: it deals special damage to the first enemy, may lower its Attack by 1 stage, and leaves a small patch of frost where it lands. The wide spectrum reaches further and chills more easily; the tight one is faster and stronger.
worldcombat.skill.aurorabeam.use.0: A straight-line pick at mid-to-long range
worldcombat.skill.aurorabeam.use.2: Leave a slick frost patch in a corridor
worldcombat.skill.aurorabeam.description: The beam flies straight along the aim line and hits only the first enemy in its path for %1$s special damage.
On hit it has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Attack by %2$s stage(s).
The beam reaches %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s-block hit radius; it leaves up to %4$s blocks of frost that linger %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.aurorabeam.spectrum.on: Wide spectrum: longer reach, thicker hitbox, bigger and longer frost, more reliable Attack drop, at the cost of slightly less power, slower travel and longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.aurorabeam.spectrum.of: Tight spectrum: a faster, stronger, cheaper beam, at the cost of reach, frost and the Attack drop.
worldcombat.skill.aurorabeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.aurorabeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the beam rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.aurorabeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the beam rises to %2$s power, %3$s blocks of frost and %4$s Attack-drop chance.
